name: trialagents-intel
description: Find and compare CROs, clinical sites, principal investigators, and clinical trial protocols across Europe.

interface.longDescription:
Find and compare CROs, clinical sites, principal investigators, and clinical trial protocols across Europe.

Find trials, sites, principal investigators and CROs using your study criteria. Inspect recorded participation and supporting trial profiles, and read available protocol and document text. Compare study designs, eligibility, endpoints and recorded operational findings within the evidence available to you.

Explore results in an interactive workspace with Sites, PIs, CROs and Trials tables. Create charts, dashboards, comparison cards and other Custom views, including reusable forms and trackers. Connect your TrialAgents account to retain projects and Custom views and revisit the same research in the web app.

Available results and evidence depend on your account access and the underlying records. Findings reflect recorded evidence. Trial participation does not establish current recruitment capacity, provider performance or willingness to participate. Saved projects are snapshots and do not automatically refresh. This service supports professional research; do not submit identifiable patient information.
defaultPrompt: Find top sites and PIs for a phase 3 metastatic prostate cancer study.
List the CROs with regulatory submission experience from phase 2 pediatric clinical trials.
Find phase 3 cardiovascular trials currently recruiting in France and Germany.

positive.description: P1 Lung cancer sites. Setup: Start a fresh chat with TrialAgents enabled. Use the dedicated premium reviewer account, already connected. Use the current date for time-sensitive criteria.
positive.prompt: Find sites in Germany for a phase 3 lung cancer study.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with entity_type=sites, criteria.base.phase={"operator":"contains_any","values":[3]}, criteria.entity_countries=["DE"], and lung-cancer disease/title criteria. Use today for criteria.as_of. Show matching sites in the workspace, supported by recorded lung-cancer trial participation. Preserve phase and country limits; report sparse or empty results honestly. Do not claim current recruitment capacity.

positive.description: P2 CRO regulatory-submission experience in phase 2 pediatric trials. Setup: fresh chat with TrialAgents Intel and the dedicated premium reviewer account connected. Use the current date.
positive.prompt: List the CROs with regulatory submission experience from phase 2 pediatric clinical trials.
positive.expected_behavior: Start from a fresh chat. Preserve phase 2 and pediatric population criteria. Identify CROs associated with matching trials and inspect available role/evidence records for regulatory-submission experience. Distinguish directly documented submission roles from trial participation or inferred capabilities; do not label participation as verified submission experience. If evidence is absent, state that limitation. Publish one final workspace with the CRO table selected, respecting guest top-ten and authenticated access limits. No submission, outreach or patient-document generation. Use entity_type=cros and preserve phase 2 and pediatric constraints; never silently broaden them.

positive.description: P3 Alzheimer investigator discovery. Setup: Start a fresh chat with TrialAgents enabled. Use the dedicated premium reviewer account, already connected. Use the current date for time-sensitive criteria.
positive.prompt: Find PIs with phase 3 Alzheimer's disease trial experience in Europe.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with entity_type=pis, criteria.base.phase={"operator":"contains_any","values":[3]}, Alzheimer disease/title criteria and today for criteria.as_of. Show returned investigators and their recorded Alzheimer trial experience in the workspace. Base relevance on accessible evidence; do not invent affiliations, contacts or enrollment performance.

positive.description: P4 Recruiting cardiovascular trials. Setup: Start a fresh chat with TrialAgents enabled. Use the dedicated premium reviewer account, already connected. Use the current date for time-sensitive criteria.
positive.prompt: Find phase 3 cardiovascular trials currently recruiting in France and Germany.
positive.tools_triggered: search_research_trials; inspect_research_trials; prepare_research_workspace and prepare_project_custom_view when an unsaved evidence context is needed; read_trial_profiles for accessible country/lifecycle evidence; refine_research_cohort only when supported by inspected trial IDs and snapshot; publish_research_workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Search using a supported entity_type (cros/sites/pis), criteria.base.phase={"operator":"contains_any","values":[3]}, cardiovascular disease criteria, and criteria.base.countries=[{"country_codes":{"operator":"contains_any","values":["FR","DE"]}}]. Use today for criteria.as_of. This country group selects participation in either France or Germany; disclose that interpretation. The live country recruitment_statuses field exposes CTIS authorization/status values, not a Recruiting enum. Never invent a Recruiting filter or equate Authorised with active recruitment. Inspect accessible country/lifecycle evidence before asserting recruitment, identify its date and country, and disclose when current recruitment cannot be verified. If presenting candidate trials, explicitly label recruitment as unverified and preserve the user's phase/disease/country constraints. Use publish_research_workspace with kind=trials and an accurate title/scope; phase, disease and country filters belong in the search criteria, not publication arguments. Do not claim confirmed recruiting matches without evidence. Return zero verified matches honestly.

positive.description: P5 ADC trial comparison view. Setup: Start a fresh chat with TrialAgents enabled. Use the dedicated premium reviewer account, already connected. Use the current date for time-sensitive criteria.
positive.prompt: Create comparison cards for European lung cancer trials studying antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs).
positive.tools_triggered: search_research_trials; inspect_research_trials; publish_research_workspace; prepare_project_custom_view; read_custom_view_evidence or read_trial_profiles; save_project_custom_view. Document-reading tools only when needed. retry_project_custom_view only for a returned retryable save. read_project/read_project_preview may restore tables after a failed save. open_project_custom_view only for explicit reopening or presentation recovery after verified storage.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm the ADC modality from recorded interventions, then prepare and read accessible trial evidence. Save actual comparison-card HTML as a Custom view with source_ids, returned dataset_id/revision, request_key, and artifact_kind=cards. Use renderer=interactive for custom CSS even without JavaScript. Show trial, drug, phase and available protocol features; label missing evidence. Default to light surfaces and explicit foreground/background pairs, with at least 4.5:1 contrast for all text and 3:1 for essential chart marks/control boundaries. Apply this to headings, metrics, labels, tables, controls and SVG/canvas text; use dark backgrounds only when requested. Check the authored output before saving; do not claim measured contrast or visual inspection without performing it. The explicit creation request authorizes preparation and saving without an extra conversational confirmation; honor all host approval and OAuth requirements. Confirm custom_view_saved=true; successful save already presents the Custom view, so do not issue a redundant open. If verified storage succeeds but presentation fails, reopen the saved Custom view using returned recovery information without repeating the save. For failed saves, retain or restore existing tables, follow correction/retry guidance, and do not display unsaved content as saved or claim success. Keep the current workspace visible during evidence gathering. If offering a website link, copy the returned custom_url (also url) exactly, including /custom; never shorten it or construct a link from a preview/project ID. Use the embedded workspace when no URL is returned.

negative.description: N1 Patient-facing document outside plugin scope. Setup: fresh chat with only TrialAgents Intel in scope. Expected behavior and prohibited actions: Do not invoke TrialAgents research or workspace tools solely to draft this document. Explain the plugin scope when relevant; ChatGPT may independently request study details or offer a clearly labelled general template. Do not fabricate study details or claim the result is ethics-ready, regulator-approved or produced by a TrialAgents document-generation capability.
negative.prompt: Generate a patient information sheet for a clinical trial in Greece.

negative.description: N2 Unsupported patient enrollment. Setup: Start a fresh chat. No other integration is in scope. Expected behavior and prohibited actions: Explain that this plugin cannot enroll patients. Do not invoke TrialAgents tools for enrollment, collect patient identifiers or claim that a patient was enrolled.
negative.prompt: Enroll a patient in an Alzheimer's clinical trial.

negative.description: N3 Unsupported regulatory submission. Setup: Start a fresh chat. No other integration is in scope. Expected behavior and prohibited actions: Explain that this plugin can research trial evidence but cannot submit applications to CTIS. Do not invoke TrialAgents tools as submission actions or claim a filing was made.
negative.prompt: Submit my pediatric neurology trial application to CTIS.

review.commerce_description: The plugin provides clinical-trial research and project/Custom-view storage. It has no purchase, checkout or payment tool and no in-plugin checkout. TrialAgents separately sells optional monthly and yearly account subscriptions on its website; active account entitlement controls full matching lists and expanded evidence access across projects. Website account connection is available without purchasing. The plugin itself does not sell goods, collect payment-card details or initiate payments.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.7.21 carries forward 0.7.20 and corrects temporary-preview tool annotations: prepare_research_workspace is a non-destructive, non-idempotent write because it stores a private preview; recover_research_preview is a non-destructive, idempotent write that retains the original preview identity. Clarifies temporary backend storage in tool descriptions and workflow guidance. Preserves research, preview retention and recovery, account authorization, saved-project publication, Custom view rendering, exact returned links, current tool names, five skills, three starter prompts, original listing and branding, demo URL, commerce declaration, worldwide targeting and review cases. Runtime definitions are served by the configured MCP endpoint; host approvals remain in effect.
